p1.title: Ley que Activa
p1.desc:
Comprehensive brand development and digital strategy for a law firm with a humanistic vision. The goal was to build a clear, professional, and accessible online presence.

Services developed:
• Digital communication strategy
• Visual identity and branding development
• SEO-oriented web design and architecture
• Creative direction and aesthetic guidelines
• Content optimization for organic positioning

Results:
Construction of a solid identity and organic growth of the digital presence.

p2.title: Desaburrite
p2.desc:
Product concept and design for an entertainment mobile app. The focus was on simplifying the user experience through an intuitive interface and clear architecture.

Services developed:
• Research and information architecture
• Wireframes and user flows design
• Interactive prototyping in Figma
• Interface design and scalable visual system
• User experience (UX) definition

Result:
Functional design ready for validation and future development stage.

p3.title: Paid Media Management
p3.desc:
Paid Media strategy for more than 60 apparel, services, and gastronomy brands. An approach that combines creativity, analysis, and constant optimization.

Services developed:
• Planning and management of Meta Ads campaigns
• Performance optimization and scalability
• Metrics and digital performance analysis
• Conversion-oriented creative development
• Segmentation strategies and continuous testing

Results:
Stable 40X ROAS on CREATE DIGITAL campaigns, with peaks of up to 94X.

about.bio:
I am passionate about marketing and advertising. I have spent years working with both Argentine and international brands and agencies. 
I transform creative ideas into sales, connecting brands with people through strategic storytelling, designing optimized websites that facilitate the user's shopping experience, and scaling results with Google and Meta Ads campaigns.
Motivated by new challenges and continuous learning, I apply creativity and strategy to drive business growth.

ugc.title: UGC & Collaborations
ugc.subtitle: USER GENERATED CONTENT
ugc.desc1: Creation of strategic and authentic content focused on organic engagement and product storytelling. Highlighting the clinical benefits of Vichy Liftactiv anti-aging serum in a dynamic and real way.
ugc.desc2: Educational and organic positioning campaign for Anthelios sunscreen, demonstrating the daily importance of protecting the skin from sun damage and digital screens.
ugc.formats: Formats optimized for TikTok, Reels, and Instagram Stories
ugc.desc_hotel_emperador: Hospitality UGC with an aesthetic look and dynamic pacing, designed to inspire travelers and spark the desire to book. A full walkthrough of the hotel experience (lobby, room, breakfast buffet, amenities and nightlife) with clear on-screen text answering what every traveler wants to know: location, how to get there and what is nearby.
ugc.ai_intro: Conceptual ad pieces created with AI tools: from idea and script to imagery, animation and final edit.
ugc.desc_spec_plusbelle: Spec ad for Plusbelle Esencia created entirely with AI tools. A humorous story starring a Persian cat and a street cat, with the warm look of retro Argentine advertising and a studio product close. Concept, script, storyboard, AI image generation and animation, and final edit.
ugc.spec_mostaza: Mostaza • New Doble Smash • Spec ad
ugc.desc_spec_mostaza: Vertical spec ad for the launch of Mostaza's New Doble Smash, created with AI. Flames, melted cheddar and the house sauce in slow motion on a black background, with ingredient callouts and a launch end card, made for Reels and TikTok.
ugc.spec_note: Unofficial concept piece, not affiliated with the brand.
